note: Triennial election of the rural district council (31 divisions), 1964: the only contest was Glenaul. No nomination was received for Corporation West or Lisnadill, where the outgoing members were deemed re-elected. Polled 4 June 1964. Magee, the sitting member, held the seat "despite allegations that his majority had been sharply reduced by errors in the register".
